overall.assessment: Podcast dosljedno brani kršćansku antropologiju, naglašavajući primarnu ulogu roditelja u odgoju djece i svetost ljudskog života od začeća. Kritika suvremenih ideoloških pristupa spolnom odgoju utemeljena je na znanstvenim spoznajama i moralnim načelima koja štite dostojanstvo osobe. Podcast potiče na odgovorno roditeljstvo i zaštitu djece od manipulacija, čime izravno doprinosi izgradnji kulture života i obitelji.
seeds_of_logos: Obrana primarnog prava i dužnosti roditelja kao prvih odgojitelja djece

overall.theological_context: Podcast se oslanja na načela iznesena u dokumentima poput 'Familiaris Consortio' (o ulozi kršćanske obitelji) i 'Amoris Laetitia' (o odgoju djece i spolnosti). Također, kritika kontracepcije i pobačaja u skladu je s naukom iz enciklike 'Humanae Vitae' i 'Evangelium Vitae', koje naglašavaju nerazdvojivost unitive i prokreacijske dimenzije bračnog čina.

sections.subtitle: Prva žena u podcastu 'Definicija': Tko je dr. Josipa?
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj predstavlja gošću, ističući njezinu ulogu supruge, majke i doktorice znanosti.
sections.content:
Voditelj otvara novu epizodu podcasta **"Definicija"** izražavajući dobrodošlicu prvoj ženskoj gošći u povijesti emisije, dr. Josipi. Predstavlja je kao suprugu, majku petero djece i doktoricu znanosti koja sa sobom donosi iznimno važnu priču o borbi za dobrobit djece i roditelja u suvremenom društvu.

Dr. Josipa ističe kako joj je iznimna čast gostovati te izražava zahvalnost što podcast otvara prostor za teme koje su od ključne važnosti za obitelji, videći u tome veliku podršku svom radu i društvenom angažmanu.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je u skladu s katoličkim naukom o važnosti obitelji i roditeljske uloge u odgoju djece. Naglasak na 'borbi za dobrobit djece' odražava crkveni poziv na zaštitu dostojanstva obitelji.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva naglašava da roditelji imaju primarnu odgovornost za odgoj svoje djece, što uključuje i područje spolnosti. Obitelj je temelj društva i prvo mjesto gdje se uči o ljubavi i darivanju.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is in accordance with Catholic teaching on the importance of the family and the parental role in the upbringing of children. The emphasis on 'the fight for the well-being of children' reflects the Church's call to protect the dignity of the family.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church emphasizes that parents have primary responsibility for the upbringing of their children, which also includes the area of sexuality. The family is the foundation of society and the first place where one learns about love and giving.

sections.subtitle_en: The first woman in the podcast 'Definicija': Who is Dr. Josipa?
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host introduces the guest, highlighting her role as a wife, mother, and doctor of science.
sections.content_en:
The host opens a new episode of the podcast **"Definicija"** by welcoming the first female guest in the history of the show, dr. Josipa. He presents her as a wife, mother of five children, and doctor of science who brings with her an extremely important story about the struggle for the well-being of children and parents in modern society.

Dr. Josipa points out that it is an exceptional honor for her to be a guest and expresses gratitude that the podcast opens up space for topics that are of crucial importance for families, seeing in this great support for her work and social engagement.

sections.subtitle: Riječki eksperiment: Kako je zdravstveni odgoj ušao u škole kroz 'rupu u zakonu'
sections.screenshot_description: Dr. Josipa objašnjava uvođenje eksperimentalnog kurikuluma u riječke osnovne škole.
sections.content:
Dr. Josipa detaljno analizira uvođenje novog kurikuluma zdravstvenog odgoja u Rijeci. Objašnjava kako je ovaj program, nakon prošlogodišnje pilot-faze, ove godine ušao u gotovo sve riječke škole kao izvannastavna aktivnost. Ističe da je gradska vlast iskoristila zakonsku pukotinu namijenjenu projektima poput učenja o Paškoj čipki ili plesnim aktivnostima kako bi uvela sadržaje koji nisu usklađeni s nacionalnim kurikulumom.

Prema njezinim riječima, iako u nacionalnom programu već postoji međupredmetna tema **"Zdravlje"**, lokalne vlasti i ideološki aktivisti inzistirali su na uvođenju vlastitog programa koji sadrži elemente rodne ideologije i nameće djeci zbunjujuće koncepte o spolu i rodu.

magisterium.assessment: Kritika uvođenja programa koji nisu usklađeni s nacionalnim kurikulumom i rodne ideologije u skladu je s crkvenim naukom o zaštiti obitelji. Crkva se protivi ideologijama koje negiraju komplementarnost spolova.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk ističe da se biološki spol i socio-kulturna uloga (rod) mogu razlikovati, ali ne i razdvajati. Ideologije koje negiraju razliku između muškarca i žene narušavaju antropološku osnovu obitelji.
magisterium.assessment_en: Criticism of the introduction of programs that are not aligned with the national curriculum and of gender ideology is in accordance with Church teaching on the protection of the family. The Church opposes ideologies that deny the complementarity of the sexes.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching emphasizes that biological sex and socio-cultural role (gender) can be distinguished, but not separated. Ideologies that deny the difference between man and woman undermine the anthropological foundation of the family.

sections.subtitle_en: Rijeka experiment: How health education entered schools through a 'loophole in the law'
sections.screenshot_description_en: Dr. Josipa explains the introduction of the experimental curriculum into Rijeka primary schools.
sections.content_en:
Dr. Josipa analyzes in detail the introduction of the new health education curriculum in Rijeka. She explains how this program, after last year's pilot phase, entered almost all Rijeka schools this year as an extracurricular activity. She points out that the city government used a legal loophole intended for projects like learning about Paška čipka or dance activities in order to introduce content that is not aligned with the national curriculum.

According to her words, although the cross-curricular topic **"Health"** already exists in the national program, local authorities and ideological activists insisted on introducing their own program which contains elements of gender ideology and imposes confusing concepts about sex and gender on children.

sections.subtitle: Epistemiološka zbunjenost i opasnosti narativa o dječjem 'pristanku'
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća analizira neurobiološki razvoj djeteta i pravne kontradikcije u kurikulumu.
sections.content:
Analizirajući kurikulum s pravnog i neurobiološkog stajališta, dr. Josipa upozorava na ozbiljno kršenje zakona, uključujući uskraćivanje prava roditelja na informirani pristanak. Posebno problematičnim smatra uvođenje pojma dječjeg **"pristanka"** na spolne odnose, što ocjenjuje kao narativ duboko ukorijenjen u pedofilskoj retorici koja djetetu daje neprimjerenu autonomiju.

Objašnjava da dječji mozak, zbog svog razvojnog stadija, nema razvijene prefrontalne strukture potrebne za regulaciju nagona i procjenu dugoročnih posljedica. Dok društvo prepoznaje dječju nedozrelost zabranom kupnje alkohola ili vožnje automobila, ovaj kurikulum čini opasan izuzetak isključivo na području seksualnosti, gurajući djecu u stanje epistemiološke zbunjenosti u kojem se subjektivni dojam stavlja iznad objektivne biološke istine.

magisterium.assessment: Upozorenje na opasnosti narativa o dječjem 'pristanku' i zaštitu djece od seksualizacije u potpunosti je usklađeno s crkvenim naukom. Crkva snažno zagovara zaštitu maloljetnika i njihovu sigurnost.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva poziva na zaštitu djece od svakog oblika zlostavljanja i iskorištavanja. Zaštita maloljetnika je prioritet, a svaki narativ koji bi mogao dovesti do njihove seksualizacije ili zlostavljanja je neprihvatljiv.
magisterium.assessment_en: Warning about the dangers of the narrative of child 'consent' and the protection of children from sexualization is fully aligned with Church teaching. The Church strongly advocates for the protection of minors and their safety.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church calls for the protection of children from every form of abuse and exploitation. The protection of minors is a priority, and every narrative that could lead to their sexualization or abuse is unacceptable.

sections.subtitle_en: Epistemological confusion and the dangers of the narrative about child 'consent'
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest analyzes the neurobiological development of the child and legal contradictions in the curriculum.
sections.content_en:
Analyzing the curriculum from a legal and neurobiological standpoint, Dr. Josipa warns of a serious violation of the law, including the denial of parents' right to informed consent. She considers particularly problematic the introduction of the concept of children's **"consent"** to sexual relations, which she assesses as a narrative deeply rooted in pedophilic rhetoric that gives the child inappropriate autonomy.

She explains that the child's brain, due to its developmental stage, does not have developed prefrontal structures necessary for the regulation of impulses and the assessment of long-term consequences. While society recognizes children's immaturity by banning the purchase of alcohol or driving a car, this curriculum makes a dangerous exception exclusively in the area of sexuality, pushing children into a state of epistemological confusion in which subjective impression is placed above objective biological truth.

sections.subtitle: Znanstveni tabu: Što se prešućuje o štetnosti kontracepcije?
sections.screenshot_description: Dr. Josipa govori o nuspojavama kontracepcijskih sredstava koje se skrivaju od mladih.
sections.content:
Gošća kritizira način na koji se u kurikulumu obrađuje tema kontracepcije, ističući da se informacije prenose izrazito površno i jednostrano. Upozorava da se takozvana **"hitna kontracepcija"**, koja zapravo ima abortivno djelovanje, predstavlja kao obična kontracepcijska metoda.

Dr. Josipa naglašava da se i u lokalnom i u nacionalnom kurikulumu sustavno prešućuju znanstveno dokazane štetne posljedice hormonske kontracepcije i spirale, poput povećanog rizika od srčanih i moždanih udara, smanjenja gustoće kostiju, upala te trajne neplodnosti. Prema njezinom mišljenju, pružanje nepotpunih informacija ne pridonosi zaštiti mladih, posebice jer adolescenti zbog visoke razine dopamina i nerazvijenih inhibijskih sinapsi u mozgu nisu u stanju donositi racionalne odluke u emocionalno nabijenim situacijama.

magisterium.assessment: Kritika kontracepcije i abortivnih sredstava u potpunosti je u skladu s enciklikom Humanae Vitae. Crkva uči da je svaki bračni čin otvoren životu i da je kontracepcija moralno neprihvatljiva.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva uči da je bračni čin po svojoj naravi sjedinjenje i prokreacija. Kontracepcija narušava tu neraskidivu vezu i protivi se Božjem naumu o darivanju života.
magisterium.assessment_en: Criticism of contraception and abortifacients is fully in accordance with the encyclical Humanae Vitae. The Church teaches that every marital act is open to life and that contraception is morally unacceptable.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church teaches that the marital act is by its nature union and procreation. Contraception disrupts this inseparable connection and opposes God's plan of giving life.

sections.subtitle_en: Scientific taboo: What is being kept silent about the harmfulness of contraception?
sections.screenshot_description_en: Dr. Josipa speaks about the side effects of contraceptives which are hidden from young people.
sections.content_en:
The guest criticizes the way in which the topic of contraception is covered in the curriculum, pointing out that information is conveyed extremely superficially and one-sidedly. She warns that the so-called **"emergency contraception"**, which actually has an abortifacient effect, is presented as an ordinary contraceptive method.

Dr. Josipa emphasizes that in both the local and the national curriculum, the scientifically proven harmful consequences of hormonal contraception and the IUD, such as an increased risk of heart attacks and strokes, decrease in bone density, inflammations, and permanent infertility, are systematically kept silent about. In her opinion, providing incomplete information does not contribute to the protection of young people, especially because adolescents, due to high levels of dopamine and undeveloped inhibitory synapses in the brain, are not able to make rational decisions in emotionally charged situations.

sections.subtitle: Zaobilaženje obitelji: Pobačaj kao 'rješenje' bez znanja roditelja
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća komentira marginalizaciju uloge roditelja u kriznim situacijama neželjene trudnoće.
sections.content:
U spornom se kurikulumu pobačaj navodi isključivo kao jedno od rješenja u slučaju neželjene trudnoće, pri čemu se u potpunosti izbjegava spomenuti da se time prekida ljudski život, ističe dr. Josipa. Ono što smatra posebno opasnim jest sustavno zaobilaženje i marginalizacija roditelja.

U trenucima emocionalne nestabilnosti i kriznih situacija, kurikulum djecu upućuje isključivo na vanjske **"stručnjake"**, dok se roditelji kao prirodni zaštitnici i primarni odgajatelji uopće ne spominju. Na taj se način obitelj svjesno eliminira iz procesa donošenja ključnih životnih odluka, ostavljajući djecu pod izravnim utjecajem ideološki usmjerenih institucija.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkim naukom o svetosti života i primarnoj ulozi roditelja u odgoju.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva snažno naglašava da su roditelji prvi i glavni odgojitelji svoje djece, a pobačaj je uvijek teški moralni prekršaj protiv života koji se ne može opravdati.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is completely aligned with Catholic teaching on the sanctity of life and the primary role of parents in upbringing.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church strongly emphasizes that parents are the first and primary educators of their children, and abortion is always a grave moral offense against life which cannot be justified.

sections.subtitle_en: Bypassing the family: Abortion as a 'solution' without the knowledge of parents
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest comments on the marginalization of the role of parents in crisis situations of unwanted pregnancy.
sections.content_en:
In the controversial curriculum, abortion is mentioned exclusively as one of the solutions in the case of an unwanted pregnancy, whereby it is completely avoided to mention that human life is thereby terminated, points out Dr. Josipa. What she considers particularly dangerous is the systematic bypassing and marginalization of parents.

In moments of emotional instability and crisis situations, the curriculum directs children exclusively to external **"experts"**, while parents as natural protectors and primary educators are not mentioned at all. In this way, the family is consciously eliminated from the process of making key life decisions, leaving children under the direct influence of ideologically oriented institutions.

sections.subtitle: Rat protiv biologije: Kako je užitak odvojen od reprodukcije
sections.screenshot_description: Dr. Josipa objašnjava evolucijski i biološki rascjep u modernom poimanju seksualnosti.
sections.content:
Dr. Josipa, govoreći iz perspektive biologa, objašnjava da se u društvu provodi sustavan ideološki preodgoj koji izravno utječe na dječju neurobiologiju. Upozorava na povijesni presedan koji se dogodio prije pedesetak godina, kada je nastao duboki rascjep između biologije i kulture. Prvi put u povijesti života na Zemlji, ljudska vrsta počinje smatrati da razmnožavanje nije poželjno, što je u suprotnosti s temeljnim biološkim nagonom za preživljavanjem i reprodukcijom koji je upisan u svaku stanicu našeg tijela.

Odvajanjem spolnosti od reprodukcije, a potom i užitka od reprodukcije, ljudsko tijelo i tijelo druge osobe svedeni su isključivo na sredstvo za zadovoljenje dopaminskih potreba. Taj proces transformacije doveo je do toga da je danas pobačaj postao vodeći uzrok smrti u svijetu, pri čemu su i same majke postale žrtve tog nesretnog procesa.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ispravno prepoznaje važnost cjelovitog pogleda na ljudsku seksualnost i opasnost od ideološkog odvajanja užitka od reprodukcije.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk uči da je seksualnost dar koji je po svojoj naravi usmjeren na sjedinjenje i prokreaciju, te da njihovo razdvajanje narušava cjelovitost ljudske osobe.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage correctly recognizes the importance of an integral view of human sexuality and the danger of the ideological separation of pleasure from reproduction.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching teaches that sexuality is a gift which is by its nature directed toward union and procreation, and that their separation violates the integrity of the human person.

sections.subtitle_en: War against biology: How pleasure is separated from reproduction
sections.screenshot_description_en: Dr. Josipa explains the evolutionary and biological split in the modern understanding of sexuality.
sections.content_en:
Dr. Josipa, speaking from the perspective of a biologist, explains that a systematic ideological re-education is being carried out in society, which directly affects children's neurobiology. She warns of a historical precedent that occurred about fifty years ago, when a deep rift arose between biology and culture. For the first time in the history of life on Earth, the human species is beginning to consider that reproduction is not desirable, which is in contradiction with the fundamental biological drive for survival and reproduction that is written into every cell of our body.

By separating sexuality from reproduction, and then pleasure from reproduction, the human body and the body of another person have been reduced exclusively to a means for satisfying dopamine needs. This process of transformation has led to abortion becoming the leading cause of death in the world today, whereby mothers themselves have also become victims of this unfortunate process.

sections.subtitle: Degradacija psihologije i prodor ideologije na fakultete
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća kritizira nedostatak neurobiologije u obrazovanju budućih psihologa.
sections.content:
Moderna psihologija nanijela je veliku štetu čovjeku jer je zanemarila biologiju i drevnu narav ljudskog tijela, smatra dr. Josipa. Pohvaljuje uvođenje evolucijske psihologije na Hrvatskom katoličkom sveučilištu, no izražava zgražanje nad činjenicom da na većini drugih studija psihologije gotovo uopće nema ozbiljne neurobiologije.

Umjesto znanstveno utemeljenih predmeta, studentima se plasiraju ideološki obojeni sadržaji, čime se, prema njezinim riječima, stvaraju ideološki aktivisti umjesto stručnjaka. Ističe da se u bibliografiji spornog riječkog kurikuluma nalazi samo jedan jedini, metodološki iznimno loš znanstveni rad, dok se sve ostalo temelji na političkim naputcima Svjetske zdravstvene organizacije i Europske unije koji nemaju uporište u neurobiologiji dječjeg razvoja.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ispravno kritizira redukcionističke pristupe u psihologiji koji zanemaruju biološku i duhovnu narav čovjeka.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potiče znanstveni pristup koji poštuje cjelovitu istinu o čovjeku, uključujući njegovu tjelesnu i duhovnu dimenziju, te upozorava na opasnosti ideologizacije znanosti.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage correctly criticizes reductionist approaches in psychology that neglect the biological and spiritual nature of man.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church encourages a scientific approach which respects the integral truth about man, including his bodily and spiritual dimension, and warns of the dangers of the ideologization of science.

sections.subtitle_en: Degradation of psychology and the penetration of ideology into faculties
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest criticizes the lack of neurobiology in the education of future psychologists.
sections.content_en:
Modern psychology has caused great harm to man because it neglected biology and the ancient nature of the human body, considers Dr. Josipa. She praises the introduction of evolutionary psychology at the Hrvatsko katoličko sveučilište, but expresses dismay over the fact that in the majority of other psychology studies there is almost no serious neurobiology at all.

Instead of scientifically based subjects, ideologically colored content is presented to students, by which, according to her words, ideological activists are created instead of experts. She points out that in the bibliography of the disputed riječki kurikulum there is only one single, methodologically extremely poor scientific paper, while everything else is based on the political guidelines of the World Health Organization and the European Union which have no foothold in the neurobiology of child development.

sections.subtitle: Sokratovska etika i niska neurotičnost: Zašto dr. Josipa ne pristaje na šutnju
sections.screenshot_description: Dr. Josipa govori o svom karakteru, duhovnosti i motivima za društvenu borbu.
sections.content:
Na pitanje voditelja o strahu od javnog istupanja i potencijalnim posljedicama za karijeru i obitelj, dr. Josipa odgovara analizom vlastitih osobina ličnosti. Ističe da ima izrazito nisku razinu neurotičnosti, što znači da strah ne upravlja njezinim odlukama. Vođena Sokratovom misli da je jedino stvarno zlo ono koje čovjek sam loše učini, objašnjava da bi joj bilo puno teže pasivno promatrati uništavanje dječjih života nego se aktivno uključiti u borbu.

Njezin primarni motiv je duboka ljubav prema djeci i želja da ih se zaštiti od onoga što je papa Benedikt XVI. nazvao **"zarobljenom savješću"** – stanja u kojem su djeca zarobljena vlastitim nagonima i onemogućena u razvoju istinske slobode i samoregulacije.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak promiče vrlinu hrabrosti i odgovornosti u javnom djelovanju, što je u skladu s kršćanskim pozivom na svjedočenje istine.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćanin je pozvan djelovati prema savjesti prosvijetljenoj vjerom, ne dopuštajući da ga strah od društvenih posljedica odvrati od zalaganja za istinu i opće dobro.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage promotes the virtue of courage and responsibility in public action, which is in accordance with the Christian calling to witness to the truth.
magisterium.enrichment_en: A Christian is called to act according to a conscience enlightened by faith, not allowing the fear of social consequences to deter him from advocating for truth and the common good.

sections.subtitle_en: Socratic ethics and low neuroticism: Why Dr. Josipa does not agree to silence
sections.screenshot_description_en: Dr. Josipa speaks about her character, spirituality, and motives for social struggle.
sections.content_en:
To the host's question about the fear of speaking out publicly and potential consequences for career and family, dr. Josipa responds with an analysis of her own personality traits. She points out that she has an extremely low level of neuroticism, which means that fear does not govern her decisions. Guided by Socrates' thought that the only real evil is that which a person himself does badly, she explains that it would be much harder for her to passively observe the destruction of children's lives than to actively get involved in the struggle.

Her primary motive is a deep love for children and a desire to protect them from what Pope Benedict XVI called a **"captive conscience"** – a state in which children are trapped by their own instincts and prevented from developing true freedom and self-regulation.

sections.subtitle: Udruga Članak 64: Ustavna obrana prava roditelja na odgoj djece
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća objašnjava pravnu pozadinu i važnost članka 64. Ustava Republike Hrvatske.
sections.content:
Gošća, dr. sc. Josipa, objašnjava kako je njezina građanska inicijativa "Karte na stol" prerasla u formalnu udrugu pod nazivom **Članak 64**. Naziv udruge izravno je inspiriran člankom 64. Ustava Republike Hrvatske, koji roditeljima jamči pravo i slobodu da samostalno odlučuju o odgoju svoje djece.

Ističe kako se zakoni mogu relativno lako mijenjati iza kulisa, no Ustav ostaje krovni državni dokument i posljednja brana protiv ideoloških pritisaka. Cilj udruge je osnažiti roditelje pružanjem točnih, znanstveno utemeljenih informacija kako bi mogli donositi informirane odluke za dobrobit svoje djece, jer se promjene u društvu ne mogu provoditi mimo roditeljskog autoriteta.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkim naukom koji roditeljima priznaje primarno, neotuđivo i izvorno pravo na odgoj djece.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni nauk, posebno u dokumentu Familiaris Consortio, naglašava da je pravo roditelja na odgoj 'izvorno i primarno' u odnosu na ulogu države ili drugih institucija. Obitelj je temeljna stanica društva koja ima pravo na zaštitu od strane države, a ne na njezino uplitanje u temeljna prava.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is fully aligned with Catholic teaching which recognizes the primary, inalienable and original right of parents to the upbringing of children.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching, especially in the document Familiaris Consortio, emphasizes that the right of parents to upbringing is 'original and primary' in relation to the role of the state or other institutions. The family is the fundamental cell of society which has the right to protection by the state, and not to its interference in fundamental rights.

sections.subtitle_en: Udruga Članak 64: Constitutional defense of parents' rights to the upbringing of children
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest explains the legal background and importance of Article 64 of the Constitution of the Republic of Croatia.
sections.content_en:
The guest, Dr. sc. Josipa, explains how her civic initiative "Karte na stol" grew into a formal association under the name **Članak 64**. The name of the association is directly inspired by Article 64 of the Constitution of the Republic of Croatia, which guarantees parents the right and freedom to independently decide on the upbringing of their children.

She points out how laws can be changed relatively easily behind the scenes, but the Constitution remains the umbrella state document and the last barrier against ideological pressures. The goal of the association is to empower parents by providing accurate, scientifically based information so that they can make informed decisions for the well-being of their children, because changes in society cannot be implemented bypassing parental authority.
keywords_en: Constitution of the Republic of Croatia
entities_en: Constitution of the Republic of Croatia

sections.subtitle: Ekstremni zapadni kurikulumi i val povratka hrvatskih obitelji iz inozemstva
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća govori o restriktivnim zakonima u Francuskoj i Njemačkoj te povratku obitelji.
sections.content:
Dr. sc. Josipa navodi primjere iz Francuske, gdje je sveobuhvatni seksualni odgoj obvezan od treće do šesnaeste godine života, čak i u katoličkim školama, dok je mogućnost obrazovanja kod kuće (*homeschooling*) maksimalno ograničena rigoroznom državnom papirologijom.

Upozorava da se u nekim zapadnim zemljama djeca od najranije dobi potiču na preispitivanje rodnog identiteta, što prosječnom Hrvatu zvuči nadrealno. Zbog takve agresivne indoktrinacije u vrtićima i školama, sve veći broj hrvatskih obitelji odlučuje se na povratak iz zemalja poput Njemačke kako bi zaštitili svoju djecu od ekstremnog ideološkog sadržaja.

magisterium.assessment: Stav je usklađen s katoličkim načelom supsidijarnosti i pravom roditelja da budu glavni odgojitelji u području spolnosti.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva se snažno protivi spolnom odgoju koji je odvojen od moralnih načela i koji ignorira roditeljsku ulogu. Prema dokumentu 'Istina i značenje ljudske spolnosti', roditelji imaju pravo i dužnost nadzirati odgoj svoje djece, a škola mora djelovati u duhu koji animira roditelje.
magisterium.assessment_en: The position is aligned with the Catholic principle of subsidiarity and the right of parents to be the primary educators in the area of sexuality.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church strongly opposes sex education which is separated from moral principles and which ignores the parental role. According to the document 'The Truth and Meaning of Human Sexuality', parents have the right and duty to supervise the education of their children, and the school must act in the spirit which animates the parents.

sections.subtitle_en: Extreme Western curricula and the wave of return of Croatian families from abroad
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest speaks about restrictive laws in France and Germany and the return of the family.
sections.content_en:
Dr. sc. Josipa cites examples from France, where comprehensive sex education is compulsory from the third to the sixteenth year of life, even in Catholic schools, while the possibility of education at home (*homeschooling*) is maximally limited by rigorous state paperwork.

She warns that in some Western countries, children from the earliest age are encouraged to question their gender identity, which sounds surreal to the average Croat. Because of such aggressive indoctrination in kindergartens and schools, an increasing number of Croatian families decide to return from countries like Germany in order to protect their children from extreme ideological content.

sections.subtitle: Bitka za djetinjstvo: Kako je kriza roditeljstva ugrozila dječji razvoj
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća analizira utjecaj tehnologije i nedostatak roditeljske prisutnosti na dječju psihologiju.
sections.content:
Prema riječima gošće, današnja kriza djetinjstva zapravo je izravna posljedica krize modernog roditeljstva. Djeca se prerano guraju u svijet odraslih kroz medije, jumbo plakate i tehnologiju, dok istovremeno gube ključnu, svjesnu prisutnost roditelja.

Dr. sc. Josipa kritizira rano slanje djece u jaslice već s godinu dana, nazivajući to tragedijom s biološkog i razvojnog stajališta. Ističe da se dječji identitet gradi kroz primarni relacijski trokut koji čine majka i otac, te da djeci kritično nedostaje stvarni roditeljski pogled i nepodijeljena pozornost kako bi se zdravo razvijala.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ispravno naglašava nezamjenjivu ulogu roditelja i obitelji kao 'domaće Crkve' u razvoju djeteta.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk uči da je obitelj 'kolijevka' u kojoj se osoba uvodi u ljudsku zajednicu i Crkvu. Iako Crkva ne zabranjuje jaslice, naglašava da je obiteljsko okruženje, ispunjeno nježnošću i prisutnošću roditelja, prirodno i nezamjenjivo mjesto za cjelovit razvoj djeteta.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage correctly emphasizes the irreplaceable role of parents and family as the 'domestic Church' in the development of the child.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching teaches that the family is the 'cradle' in which a person is introduced into the human community and the Church. Although the Church does not forbid nurseries, it emphasizes that the family environment, filled with tenderness and the presence of parents, is the natural and irreplaceable place for the integral development of the child.

sections.subtitle_en: The Battle for Childhood: How the Crisis of Parenting Threatened Child Development
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest analyzes the influence of technology and the lack of parental presence on child psychology.
sections.content_en:
According to the words of the guest, today's crisis of childhood is actually a direct consequence of the crisis of modern parenting. Children are pushed too early into the world of adults through media, billboards, and technology, while at the same time they lose the crucial, conscious presence of parents.

Dr. sc. Josipa criticizes the early sending of children to nurseries already at one year of age, calling it a tragedy from a biological and developmental standpoint. She points out that children's identity is built through the primary relational triangle made up of mother and father, and that children critically lack the real parental gaze and undivided attention in order to develop healthily.

sections.subtitle: Neurobiologija odgoja: Zašto su djetetu potrebne granice, frustracija i dosada
sections.screenshot_description: Vizualni prikaz objašnjenja o dopaminskom sustavu i važnosti dječje igre.
sections.content:
Gošća detaljno objašnjava neurobiološku važnost postavljanja granica i uvođenja blage frustracije u odgoj. Kada roditelji instantno ugađaju svakom dječjem nagonu, sprječavaju razvoj samoregulacije i sinapsi u mozgu zaduženih za kontrolu ponašanja.

Ističe da je dosada ključna jer potiče kreativnost i slobodnu igru, koja je najbolji i najzdraviji način stimulacije dopaminskog sustava. Kroz igru s drugima, dijete uči čekati svoj red, nositi se s malim frustracijama i razvijati samokontrolu, što ga priprema za odrasli život i sposobnost žrtvovanja za druge.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je usklađen s biblijskim i katehetskim naukom o važnosti discipline (paideia) i odgoja u krepostima.
magisterium.enrichment: Sveto pismo (Ef 6,4) i Katekizam (2223) potiču roditelje da djecu odgajaju u 'disciplini i pouci Gospodnjoj'. Disciplina, koja uključuje postavljanje granica i odricanje, nužan je preduvjet za istinsku slobodu i razvoj samokontrole, što je ključno za kršćanski život.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is aligned with biblical and catechetical teaching on the importance of discipline (paideia) and upbringing in virtues.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Sacred Scripture (Eph 6:4) and the Catechism (2223) encourage parents to raise children in the 'discipline and instruction of the Lord'. Discipline, which includes setting boundaries and self-denial, is a necessary prerequisite for true freedom and the development of self-control, which is crucial for Christian life.

sections.subtitle_en: Neurobiology of upbringing: Why a child needs boundaries, frustration, and boredom
sections.screenshot_description_en: Visual representation of the explanation about the dopamine system and the importance of children's play.
sections.content_en: The guest explains in detail the neurobiological importance of setting boundaries and introducing mild frustration into upbringing. When parents instantly gratify every child's impulse, they prevent the development of self-regulation and synapses in the brain responsible for controlling behavior. She emphasizes that boredom is crucial because it encourages creativity and free play, which is the best and healthiest way of stimulating the dopamine system. Through play with others, the child learns to wait their turn, cope with small frustrations, and develop self-control, which prepares them for adult life and the ability to sacrifice for others.

sections.subtitle: Majčinstvo i očinstvo kao vrhunski poziv nasuprot diktatu karijere
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća govori o vrijednosti obitelji i društvenim zabludama o karijernom uspjehu žena.
sections.content:
Dr. sc. Josipa upozorava da je moderno društvo prestalo odgajati djecu za uloge majke i oca, namećući im karijerni pritisak kao jedino mjerilo vrijednosti. Žene se često uvjerava da je rad na pokretnoj traci ili u korporaciji važniji od stvaranja i odgoja novog ljudskog života.

Kao doktorica znanosti, gošća naglašava da nijedan njezin znanstveni rad niti poslovni uspjeh ne može biti važniji od njezine uloge majke i vremena provedenog s djetetom. Kritizira i povijesne savjete modernih stručnjaka koji su zbunili roditelje, poput teorija da bebe treba pustiti da plaču, što dokazano ostavlja trajne neurobiološke posljedice na dječju otpornost na stres.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj snažno promiče katolički nauk o primatu obiteljskog poziva i roditeljske odgovornosti u odgoju djece, suprotstavljajući se suvremenom sekularnom pritisku karijerizma.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni nauk naglašava da je obitelj 'prva škola kršćanskih vrlina' (KKC 2223) i da roditelji imaju primarno i neotuđivo pravo i dužnost odgajati svoju djecu (KKC 2221, Familiaris Consortio 36).
magisterium.assessment_en: The content strongly promotes Catholic teaching on the primacy of the family vocation and parental responsibility in the upbringing of children, opposing the contemporary secular pressure of careerism.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching emphasizes that the family is 'the first school of Christian virtues' (CCC 2223) and that parents have the primary and inalienable right and duty to educate their children (CCC 2221, Familiaris Consortio 36).

sections.subtitle_en: Motherhood and fatherhood as a supreme vocation versus the dictate of career
sections.screenshot_description_en: The female guest speaks about the value of family and social misconceptions about the career success of women.
sections.content_en:
Dr. sc. Josipa warns that modern society has stopped raising children for the roles of mother and father, imposing career pressure on them as the only measure of value. Women are often convinced that work on an assembly line or in a corporation is more important than the creation and upbringing of a new human life.

As a doctor of science, the guest emphasizes that none of her scientific work nor business success can be more important than her role as a mother and the time spent with the child. She also criticizes the historical advice of modern experts who have confused parents, such as theories that babies should be left to cry, which is proven to leave permanent neurobiological consequences on children's resilience to stress.

sections.subtitle: Roditeljska budnost: Kako spriječiti ideološku indoktrinaciju u školama
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća objašnjava mehanizme ulaska udruga u škole i važnost uskraćivanja suglasnosti.
sections.content:
U Hrvatskoj je zdravstveni odgoj koji sadrži elemente rodne ideologije trenutačno uveden kao izvannastavna aktivnost, što znači da roditelji moraju dati izričitu suglasnost. Dr. sc. Josipa poziva roditelje na maksimalnu budnost jer razne udruge često ulaze u škole kroz satove razrednika, koristeći nepažnju roditelja ili prešutne suglasnosti.

Iako su roditelji preopterećeni borbom za egzistenciju, moraju aktivno pratiti što se događa u školama i koristiti svoja zakonska prava kako bi zaštitili vrijednosni odgoj svoje djece.

magisterium.assessment: Usklađeno s crkvenim naukom o pravu roditelja na odgoj djece i upozorenjem na ideološku kolonizaciju kroz rodnu ideologiju.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva jasno upozorava na 'rodnu ideologiju' koja niječe komplementarnost spolova i nastoji nametnuti antropologiju odvojenu od biološke stvarnosti (Amoris Laetitia 56, 'Male and Female He Created Them' 2).
magisterium.assessment_en: Aligned with Church teaching on the right of parents to the upbringing of children and the warning against ideological colonization through gender ideology.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church clearly warns against 'gender ideology' which denies the complementarity of the sexes and seeks to impose an anthropology separated from biological reality (Amoris Laetitia 56, 'Male and Female He Created Them' 2).

sections.subtitle_en: Parental vigilance: How to prevent ideological indoctrination in schools
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest explains the mechanisms of the entry of associations into schools and the importance of withholding consent.
sections.content_en:
In Croatia, health education which contains elements of gender ideology is currently introduced as an extracurricular activity, which means that parents must give explicit consent. Dr. sc. Josipa calls parents to maximum vigilance because various associations often enter schools through homeroom teacher hours, using the inattention of parents or tacit consents.

Although parents are overburdened with the struggle for existence, they must actively monitor what is happening in schools and use their legal rights in order to protect the value-based education of their children.

sections.subtitle: Spolni odgoj u obitelji: Kako kroz ljubav i priču izgraditi zdravu spolnost
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća objašnjava važnost bračnog odnosa kao temelja dječjeg poimanja spolnosti.
sections.content:
Asocirajući na svoje iskustvo majke petero djece, dr. sc. Josipa ističe da najraniji i najvažniji spolni odgoj počinje promatranjem odnosa između majke i oca. Kroz njihovu nježnost, poštovanje i pomirenje nakon nesuglasica, dijete uči povezivati tjelesnost s ljubavlju i zajedništvom.

Gošća savjetuje roditeljima da ne bježe od dječjih pitanja, već da čekaju da ih djeca sama postave te im ponude odgovore prilagođene njihovoj dobi. Naglašava važnost obiteljskog razgovora i pričanja priča, upozoravajući na poražavajuću statistiku prema kojoj roditelji u prosjeku razgovaraju s djecom svega osam do devet minuta dnevno. Bez zdravog obiteljskog narativa, djeca će odgovore potražiti u lošim i štetnim sadržajima na internetu.

magisterium.assessment: Izvrsno odražava katoličko shvaćanje spolnog odgoja kao dijela cjelovitog odgoja za ljubav, gdje roditelji imaju ključnu ulogu.
magisterium.enrichment: Spolni odgoj treba biti dio šireg odgoja za ljubav i uzajamno darivanje, a ne samo tehnička informacija (Amoris Laetitia 280, 283).
magisterium.assessment_en: It excellently reflects the Catholic understanding of sex education as a part of integral education for love, where parents have a key role.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Sex education should be part of a broader education for love and mutual giving, and not just technical information (Amoris Laetitia 280, 283).

sections.subtitle_en: Sexual education in the family: How to build healthy sexuality through love and story
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest explains the importance of the marital relationship as the foundation of children's understanding of sexuality.
sections.content_en:
Associating with her experience as a mother of five children, dr. sc. Josipa points out that the earliest and most important sex education begins by observing the relationship between mother and father. Through their tenderness, respect, and reconciliation after disagreements, the child learns to connect physicality with love and communion.

The guest advises parents not to run away from children's questions, but to wait for the children to ask them themselves and to offer them answers adapted to their age. She emphasizes the importance of family conversation and storytelling, warning of devastating statistics according to which parents on average talk to their children for only eight to nine minutes a day. Without a healthy family narrative, children will look for answers in bad and harmful content on the internet.

sections.subtitle: Blic pitanja: Opredjeljenje za obitelj, stroga pravila i društveni aktivizam
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća s osmijehom odgovara na brza blic pitanja voditelja.
sections.content:
U zabavnom i dinamičnom dijelu emisije, voditelj postavlja gošći niz blic pitanja u kojima se mora odlučiti između dviju opcija. Dr. sc. Josipa bez oklijevanja bira "punu kuću djece" ispred znanstvenog laboratorija, a između roditeljskog sastanka i TV sučeljavanja bira stvarni susret s ljudima na roditeljskom sastanku.

Kada je riječ o odgojnim metodama, odlučno bira "stroga pravila" jer smatra da su djeca sretnija kada jasno znaju granice. Na pitanje o životnom cilju za svoju djecu, zaključuje kako joj je jedini i najveći motiv da njezina djeca postanu sveta, što zahtijeva i hrabrost i istinski uspjeh.

magisterium.assessment: Uglavnom usklađeno s katoličkim naglaskom na obiteljske vrijednosti, iako 'stroga pravila' zahtijevaju mudrost u primjeni.
concerns: Potrebno je paziti da 'stroga pravila' ne postanu legalizam koji zanemaruje duh ljubavi i razumijevanja (usp. Ef 6,4).
magisterium.enrichment: Odgoj zahtijeva ravnotežu između discipline i nježnosti; roditelji su pozvani odgajati djecu u 'disciplini i pouci Gospodnjoj' (Ef 6,4), izbjegavajući izazivanje gnjeva kod djece (KKC 2223).
magisterium.assessment_en: Mainly aligned with the Catholic emphasis on family values, although 'strict rules' require wisdom in application.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Upbringing requires a balance between discipline and tenderness; parents are called to bring up children in the 'discipline and instruction of the Lord' (Eph 6:4), avoiding provoking anger in children (CCC 2223).
concerns_en: It is necessary to take care that 'strict rules' do not become legalism which neglects the spirit of love and understanding (cf. Eph 6:4).

sections.subtitle_en: Flash questions: Commitment to family, strict rules and social activism
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest answers the host's quick blitz questions with a smile.
sections.content_en:
In the fun and dynamic part of the show, the host asks the guest a series of blitz questions in which she must decide between two options. Dr. sc. Josipa without hesitation chooses "a house full of children" over a scientific laboratory, and between a parent-teacher meeting and a TV confrontation, she chooses a real meeting with people at a parent-teacher meeting.

When it comes to upbringing methods, she decisively chooses "strict rules" because she believes that children are happier when they clearly know the boundaries. To the question about the life goal for her children, she concludes that her only and greatest motive is for her children to become holy, which requires both courage and true success.

sections.subtitle: Završna poruka i najava: Svjedočanstvo vjere iza zatvorskih rešetaka
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj odjavljuje emisiju i najavljuje idućeg gosta Darija s krunicom.
sections.content:
Voditelj zahvaljuje dr. sc. Josipi na iznimno bogatom i poučnom razgovoru, izražavajući nadu za ponovnim gostovanjem kako bi se dodatno proširile ove važne teme. Nakon odjave emisije i poziva gledateljima da podrže podcast "Definicija" na društvenim mrežama i Patreonu, prikazan je kratki isječak i najava sljedeće epizode.

U njoj će gostovati Dario, koji dijeli svoje dirljivo svjedočanstvo o tome kako je s krunicom u ruci i blagoslovljenom vodom šetao među zatvorenicima, svjedočio vjeru te se molio za njih na njihov vlastiti zahtjev, bez obzira na njihovu vjersku pripadnost.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkim naukom o primarnoj ulozi roditelja u odgoju djece, uključujući spolni odgoj.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni nauk naglašava da su roditelji prvi i najvažniji odgojitelji svoje djece, a škola i druge institucije imaju pomoćnu ulogu (supsidijarnost). Spolni odgoj mora biti integriran u cjeloviti odgoj za ljubav i čistoću, a ne sveden na puku biologiju ili ideologiju.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is fully aligned with Catholic teaching on the primary role of parents in the upbringing of children, including sexual education.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching emphasizes that parents are the first and most important educators of their children, and school and other institutions have an auxiliary role (subsidiarity). Sex education must be integrated into the integral education for love and chastity, and not reduced to mere biology or ideology.

sections.subtitle_en: Final message and announcement: Testimony of faith behind prison bars
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host signs off the show and announces the next guest Dario with the Rosary.
sections.content_en:
The host thanks Dr. Sc. Josipa for an exceptionally rich and instructive conversation, expressing hope for a repeat guest appearance in order to further expand on these important topics. After the sign-off of the show and a call to the viewers to support the podcast "Definicija" on social networks and Patreon, a short clip and an announcement of the next episode were shown.

In it, Dario will appear as a guest, who shares his touching testimony about how he, with a Rosary in hand and holy water, walked among prisoners, witnessed the faith, and prayed for them at their own request, regardless of their religious affiliation.

iterations.theme_en: Udruga Članak 64, crisis of parenting, protection of children and sex education in the family
